title: Pre-RoPE canonical cache with deferred position and View transforms
hypothesis: A position-free content K/V cache plus per-view structured Givens coordinates can reproduce explicitly re-encoded RoPE attention within 1e-5 across arbitrary positions while using <=25% of the actual serialized 8-view cache payload at T=128; because these views need not commute with RoPE, they cannot generally be moved to one position-independent query transform.
physical_object: one FP32 content-space K/V cache before RoPE
mirror_coordinate: per-view structured cross-plane Givens angles applied to content keys before per-position RoPE, plus value-view angles after attention
logical_multiplicity: 8 position-specific logical KV views over one content cache
controls: independent materialized per-view RoPE K/V cache
native Givens coordinates with identical execution

development.selection_metric: maximum relative attention-output error, actual NPZ payload bytes, and operation proxy; no tuning

success_gate: All 3 locked audit seeds: lazy kernel result vs explicit cache maximum relative output error <=1e-5; actual shared serialized payload <=25% independent per-view cache bytes; native Givens control alias is reported as no Mirror-specific attribution even if algebra/storage pass.
failure_gate: Any audit seed exceeds 1e-5 error or serialized payload exceeds 25%. Position-independent query approximation should fail by >1e-2 on at least one seed; otherwise the noncommutation boundary is not established.
boundaries: Synthetic FP32 attention only, D=16, T=128, 8 views; no model training, language task, GPU kernel, TTFT, or production throughput claim.
View transforms are structured orthogonal Givens rotations mixing coordinates from different RoPE planes; value transforms use per-plane rotations.
Report analytic MAC-equivalents and NumPy wall time descriptively; attention arithmetic is common and excluded from incremental transform proxy.
